paragraphs: Rav Huna Mar bar Avya said to Rav Ashi: Chullin 47a. But at 58b it has bar Chiyya. Rav Ashi said, “I saw Rav Huna bar Avya in a dream”: Bava Batra 143a. See above, Rav Mordekhai.
